idle.purpose: relaxed breathing stance, weight drifting between the feet
idle.maps_to: alive, not moving, out of combat (no enemy near, no attack for 2 s; hub)

idle_combat.purpose: combat-ready stance: guard up, a light bounce on the knees
idle_combat.maps_to: alive, not moving, in combat (enemies near or an attack in the last 2 s). Frame 0 is the reference pose of every upper-layer clip

walk.purpose: heavy walk, gauntlets swinging at the sides
walk.maps_to: moving at under about 55 % of move speed (stick partly pushed, slows); playback rate = speed / 1.80 m/s

run.purpose: brawler run: forward lean, gauntlets pumping in front of the ribs
run.maps_to: moving within 45 deg of the aim at move speed; playback rate = speed / 6.2 m/s

strafe_left.purpose: side run to the hero's left, hips opened toward the travel, chest and guard kept on the aim
strafe_left.maps_to: moving 45-135 deg to the left of the aim; playback rate = speed / 6.2 m/s

strafe_right.purpose: side run to the hero's right (the mirror of strafe_left)
strafe_right.maps_to: moving 45-135 deg to the right of the aim; playback rate = speed / 6.2 m/s

backpedal.purpose: backpedal on the balls of the feet, guard up, weight forward
backpedal.maps_to: moving more than 135 deg away from the aim; playback rate = speed / 6.2 m/s

dash.purpose: the dash burst: a low shoulder-led lunge-glide, the lead gauntlet driving forward, the rear one trailing
dash.maps_to: the 0.16 s dash (MoverState.dash_left > 0); the client faces the hero along the dash for its duration

dash_recover.purpose: landing out of the dash: the lead foot plants, a heavy absorb, back to the guard
dash_recover.maps_to: the first 0.45 s after a dash ends when the hero is not moving on (else blend into locomotion)

fire_light.purpose: generic light shot: the weapon hand thrusts along the aim and snaps back (recoil stays procedural)
fire_light.maps_to: each primary shot of a light chassis (fire_rate >= 2/s); Brax plays brax_jab_l / brax_jab_r instead

fire_heavy.purpose: generic heavy shot: load back, both arms drive forward, the body takes the kick
fire_heavy.maps_to: a heavy / charged release (fire_rate < 1/s, charge release, splash chassis)

fire_charge.purpose: holding a charge: rear hand loaded at the hip, braced, trembling with stored power
fire_charge.maps_to: fire held on a Charge chassis (FireKind::Charge) until release (then fire_heavy)

hit_light.purpose: a flinch: head snaps, the guard is knocked back, absorb, recover
hit_light.maps_to: PlayerFlags::HIT on a light hit (damage < 10 % max HP), layered over whatever plays

hit_heavy.purpose: a big stagger: blown back, the lead foot steps back, absorb low, step back in
hit_heavy.maps_to: PlayerFlags::HIT on a heavy hit (damage >= 10 % max HP or a stun); interrupts upper-layer clips

knockdown.purpose: blown off the feet: impact, a backward fall, the bounce, lying on the back
knockdown.maps_to: a knockback / launch strong enough to floor the hero (stun >= 0.8 s); holds its last frame until get_up

get_up.purpose: from the back: sit up on the hands, roll onto one knee, push up into the guard

death.purpose: the fatal blow: head snaps back, knees buckle to the ground, topples face down
death.maps_to: LifeState::Downed begins (GameEvent::Downed); holds its last frame, then downed@loop (wraith look)

downed.purpose: the wraith drift: slumped, floating 0.35 m off the ground, limbs trailing, a slow bob
downed.maps_to: LifeState::Downed (the Soul-Tether wraith; moves at 45 % speed with no gait, the client adds the ghost material)

revive.purpose: pulled back into the body: a jolt, the feet slam down, crouch, rise into the guard
revive.maps_to: an ally completes the Soul-Tether revive (Downed -> Alive)

reforge_in.purpose: forged anew: rises from a one-knee landing (fist planted), clashes the gauntlets, takes the guard
reforge_in.maps_to: LifeState::Reforging ends: the hero reappears next to an ally

victory.purpose: the roar: a crouch, then one gauntlet thrust to the sky, chest out; holds the pose
victory.maps_to: the run is won (GameEvent victory / boss down, results screen); holds its last frame

ping.purpose: a ping: the right arm points along the aim with the hand open, the head follows
ping.maps_to: the ping / marker input (party callout); the open gauntlet variant shows while the hand is open

interact.purpose: work the anvil: lean over and press both gauntleted fists onto it (knuckles down), then straighten
interact.maps_to: the interact input at an anvil / forge / shrine POI (PoiState use); 1.3 s

forge_hammer.purpose: hammering the anvil with the right fist, the left fist bracing the work
forge_hammer.maps_to: the forge / hub anvil upgrade (Forge screen open, hub idle at the anvil)

idle_signature.purpose: signature idle: rolls each shoulder, cracks the neck side to side, knocks the gauntlets together twice
idle_signature.maps_to: alive and idle for 6 s or more (out of combat); in the hub and the character select

jab_l.purpose: lead jab: the left gauntlet snaps straight down the aim line and back
jab_l.maps_to: anvil_gauntlets strike (fire_rate 3/s), alternating with jab_r; the strike lands on frame 3

jab_r.purpose: rear straight: hips and the rear heel turn, the right gauntlet drives down the aim line
jab_r.maps_to: anvil_gauntlets strike (fire_rate 3/s), alternating with jab_l; the strike lands on frame 3

hook.purpose: lead hook: load to the left, the torso whips through, the left gauntlet sweeps across at head height
hook.maps_to: every third strike of a held string, and every strike at max Heat (ignite + stagger); lands on frame 6

uppercut.purpose: Cinder Uppercut: coil low, a rising uppercut that launches, a hang, a double-fist slam into the ground
uppercut.maps_to: kits.ron brax active1 Cinder Uppercut: Nova (launch) on 'launch', Field (flame geysers) on 'slam'

furnace_rush.purpose: Furnace Rush: head down behind both gauntlets like a ram, legs churning, very low
furnace_rush.maps_to: kits.ron brax active2 Furnace Rush while the Rush moves (8 m in 0.4 s = 12 frames); the enemy drag is sim-side
furnace_rush.notes: stylised: the rush moves at 20 m/s, the legs churn at an 8 m/s stride (a skid-charge), so the feet slide by design

furnace_rush_end.purpose: the brake: the lead foot plants in a skid, both gauntlets shove the dragged line away, back to the guard
furnace_rush_end.maps_to: Furnace Rush ends (after 0.4 s): the drag releases on 'release'

meltdown_start.purpose: Meltdown ignition: gather low, a chest-out roar with the arms flung wide, the gauntlets slam together
meltdown_start.maps_to: kits.ron brax ultimate Meltdown cast: the buff starts on 'ignite', the clash is the shockwave VFX cue

meltdown.purpose: Meltdown stance: lower and wider, fists forward, a fast bounce and rolling shoulders
meltdown.maps_to: replaces idle_combat while the Meltdown buff lasts (8 s); strikes layer on top as usual

heat_vent.purpose: Heat vent: shoulders thrown back, arms dropped wide, chest out, head back as the cracks vent
heat_vent.maps_to: the Heat Gauge passive reaches max (attacks start to ignite); the steam / ember VFX sit on chest_sigil
